hook: Law enforcement seized 241 hidden crypto scam domains targeting Russian speakers in a massive cross-border raid.

sections.voiceover: Law enforcement seized 241 hidden crypto scam domains targeting Russian speakers in a massive cross-border raid.
b_roll: Digital server rack flashing red lights in a dark room
Close up of domain registration code scrolling on a computer screen

sections.voiceover: Investigators in Brooklyn dismantled an Eastern European fraud network stealing millions. Where were the servers hidden?
b_roll: Exterior shot of Brooklyn courthouse under grey sky
Map highlighting Eastern Europe connected to New York servers

sections.voiceover: Worse, investigators found 112 industrial servers powering the entire operation across Eastern Europe.
b_roll: Server room lights powering down one by one
Data stream abruptly cutting off on a monitor

sections.voiceover: The Virtual Currency Unit crushed the multinational investment scam targeting Russian speakers. Americans lost tens of millions of dollars before the Brooklyn District Attorney stepped in.
b_roll: Cryptocurrency wallet interface showing zeroed out balances
Law enforcement documents stamped with official seals

sections.voiceover: The Brooklyn District Attorney's office permanently shut down 241 domains.
b_roll: Power cable being unplugged from a humming server rack
Darkened server room glowing with faint emergency lights
